2.t: CONTROL TEST

Easy Cabinet Configuration UltraCade was designed with the operator in mind! The easy-to-use operator interface enables the operator to load new games, show or hide individual games, sort the games by their AAMA rating or sort by earnings using the patent pending Intelli-Earn™ feature. The more money a particular game in a locations earns, the more often Intelli-Earn™ cycles that games attract mode. The Operator can also adjust parameters such as coin settings and level of difficulty. UltraCade supports vertical and horizontal monitor configurations as well as single player (counter top) and cocktail table modes. In cocktail mode, the screen automatically flips in 2 player games!

UltraCade’s sophisticated accounting engine has the ability to track earnings for each game and can display the results sorted by name, manufacturer or earnings. UltraCade can save earnings to a floppy disk for use with spreadsheet and financial applications.

Easy Testing Features With UltraCade’s diagnostics engine, troubleshooting is a snap! From the easy to use operator interface, the operator can test all the buttons, joysticks, sound and the monitor. The entire JAMMA harness can also be displayed graphically on screen to help detect shorts as well as faulty components or wiring.
